Official DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility update, readable light/dark surfaces and semantic contrast fix, and QA deletion synchronization.

Support official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` while retaining `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.5` compatibility (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`).

Replace undefined surface token `--dsw-alias-bg-primary` with official `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1` across supported theme packages, fixing dark background fallback artifacts on light theme console and preflight dialogs.

Decouple semantic text ink from decorative background tints: introduce high-contrast green/brown ink in light mode and pale green/amber ink under `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` for badge, Keep, evidence chip, self-check, warning, and score text over tinted surfaces. Decouple the Mute button to distinct blue fill and white text to resolve unreadable `currentColor` styling. (Scope covers measured readable green/amber status, self-check, and Mute; pre-existing red/danger states remain ~2.87-3.91 light / ~2.92-4.05 dark; native tertiary light text is also < 4.5:1. No blanket full WCAG claim.)

Official DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 declares Node `>=24.9.0` (latest host QA on Node 24.13), while older official hosts continue running on Node 22 (Node 22.19) without imposing a global Node floor on older setups.

Fix acceptance fixture synchronization: await actual `deleteOwnedSession` and manifest completion before listing sessions, eliminating a race condition in test enumeration while ensuring the normal `/qa/state` route continues to propagate all missing-session errors without catchalls.

支持官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`（同时保留对 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.5` 的兼容，声明范围为 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`）。

将未定义的表面令牌 `--dsw-alias-bg-primary` 修正为全官方主题包一致定义的 `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1`，修复浅色主题下控制台与预检弹窗背景发黑的问题。

将语义墨水与装饰底色解耦：在浅色模式及深色模式（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）下分别为徽章、Keep 状态、证据标签、自检、警告及分数文本配置高对比度墨水色；将静音按钮解耦为独立蓝色底色与白色文字，解决原 `currentColor` 导致文字不可读的缺陷。（注：范围限定于已实测的高对比度绿/琥珀色状态、自检与静音按钮，非全量文本或全部 WCAG 声明；历史负向红色状态仍保留约 2.87-3.91 浅色 / 2.92-4.05 深色非阻塞可读范围；宿主浅色三级文本亦低于 4.5:1）。

官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 声明 Node `>=24.9.0`（最新宿主 QA 基于 Node 24.13），旧版官方宿主仍继续运行于 Node 22（Node 22.19），不强加全局 Node 最低版本。

修复验收测试夹具同步：等待实际的 `deleteOwnedSession` 和清单完成写入后再枚举会话，消除测试枚举中的时序竞争，同时保留正常 `/qa/state` 路由对所有缺失会话错误的直接向上抛出。

Declared DSH range: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`. Keep the previous plugin version on older DSH. See [Validation records](.github/reviews/dsh-0.2.2-rc.1.md) and [round 2](.github/reviews/dsh-0.2.2-rc.1-round2.md).

Validation: automated regression suite (`npm test`, 27 test files), client bundle verification (`npm run check:client`), npm package check (`npm run check:package`, 11 runtime files), publication workflow tests (10/10 checks), peer checks across all four official runtimes (`0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.2-rc.1`), and independent Opus validation in real headless Edge 156 against official latest and oldest runtimes with zero page/console errors.

Install from npm or the attached archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-rollout-scout-1.9.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH after updating.
